title: Foundation Audit Fields
description: Minimum audit metadata. This schema does not implement an audit store or retention policy.

x-field-purposes.actorRef: Reference the actor supplied by the caller boundary.
x-field-purposes.traceId: Join the operation to a distributed trace.
x-field-purposes.scenarioContext: Bind the operation to one C033 scenario/version/run.
x-field-purposes.sourceVersion: Record the source version read or migrated from.
x-field-purposes.targetVersion: Record the target version compared or migrated to.
x-field-purposes.formedAt: Record when the audit metadata was formed.
x-field-purposes.operation: Name the stable operation that produced the metadata.
x-field-purposes.outcome: Record the operation outcome without becoming business truth.

oneOf.description: Non-empty identity reference object; identity and authorization semantics remain outside Foundation.

sourceVersion.description: Version from which the operation reads or migrates.

targetVersion.description: Version to which the operation targets or compares.

formedAt.description: Time the audit metadata was formed.

outcome.description: Operation outcome summary; not a business truth store.
